statements.statement: An article amending the FY2027 omnibus budget was voted into the November 17 special town meeting warrant.
A transfer from certified free cash to the special education reserve fund was voted onto the warrant; amount not yet set by school committee.
Town manager said a substantial amount of free cash was left unexpended after May town meeting.
Track and field engineering services article amount; held off the warrant pending presentation.
A member said health insurance is predicted to rise 8 to 10% and inflation 3.5%, and the school committee is already at a deficit.

warnings.prediction: Budget season could be bleak given inflation, health insurance increases and an existing school deficit
The town should get through one year without an override proposition before asking for building money; a member is concerned an override will fail
Tension between school and town budgets will persist because no new money is coming

warnings.condition: if funded through the operating budget rather than an enterprise fund
warnings.prediction: Funding stormwater from the operating budget would strain the rest of the budget and likely bring a more immediate override
